statement.zh: 舒鲁帕克（法拉）可由早期发掘与现存记录重建，见 Martin 1988（强二级；不能替代已佚原始田野簿）。
statement.en: Shuruppak (Fara) can be reconstructed from early excavations and surviving records, as synthesized in Martin 1988 (strong secondary; not a substitute for lost primary fieldbooks).
